Hi Samantha / Tessa,

Thanks for the docs. A few finance items to close out before AP activation:

1) W-8BEN-E: Please complete and sign the W-8BEN-E form (we need the PDF with a signature). Because Aurelia is an Australian entity (non-US), this is the standard form we collect to support our US tax files and to determine whether withholding applies. If you claim any treaty benefits, please include the treaty article.

2) GST handling: Since Aurelia is GST-registered in AU, GST should appear as a separate line on your invoice. For services rendered to a US company, GST typically does not apply for export of services, but we still accept invoices that show GST with ABN/GST certificate attached — AP will zero-rate where appropriate. We are not asking for reverse-charge treatment on our side (that generally applies in EU VAT scenarios).

3) Invoice requirements:
   - Invoice must reference RDW-PO- number (we use RDW- prefix).
   - Include ABN and GST registration number on the invoice header.
   - Currency: Redwood prefers USD for AP processing; if you invoice in AUD, please include an AUD->USD conversion note.
   - Email invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com

4) Bank details: We need bank name, BSB/SWIFT, account name and number, and a bank confirmation letter if the account is not in Aurelia's legal name.

Timeline: Once we receive signed W-8BEN-E + completed onboarding form + bank confirmation, AP activation typically completes within 5 business days.

Samantha — could you upload the signed W-8BEN-E to the DocuSign link (or attach in reply) and confirm whether you prefer USD invoices?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
